{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# This workflow will build a Java project with Maven, and cache/restore any dependencies to improve the workflow execution time
# For more information see: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/automating-builds-and-tests/building-and-testing-java-with-maven

name: Error Prone Check

on:
  push:
    branches: ['master']
  pull_request:
    branches: ['master']

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v3
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven
      - name: Build with Maven
        run: mvn -P error-prone-check clean compile --file pom.xml",
  "rationale": "Dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) is already satisfied by the existing setup-java cache: maven, and there is no matrix so P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not apply. Repository CI history shows five successful runs with short, representative durations, satisfying the P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT precondition that representative successful-duration history exists. Adding a job timeout with operational headroom bounds runaway consumption without changing the build steps, test coverage, permissions, secrets, or network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
